'''Krossen''', also known as '''XK-7''', was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-immune [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] created during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Bitt Panith]]. Krossen looked as if he was put together from many different creatures: His [[Limb/Legends|arms]] were from a [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]], and his legs from a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]]. His [[Blood/Legends|blood]] came from a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], which made it immune to the Force. He wore a metal mask and silver armor all over his body. Project Krossen was scheduled for mass-production against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but the prototype was defeated by [[Bant Eerin's Padawan]] and a clone named [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Lex (clone trooper)|Lex]] before it could be perfected.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />
